contexts.text: Spices, gum, and stacte () = interior natural truths conjoined with good there. Explained, Illustrated.

What the spices, gums, and stacte here signify in special, may be evident from the other passages where they are mentioned. In general, they = interior truths in the Natural, but which are from good there...

A little resin, and a little honey () = the truths of exterior natural good, and its delight. Resin = the truth of good, or truth from good. The reason resin has this signification, is that it ranks among ointments, and also among aromatics... That this resin was aromatic, see ; and on this account the same expression in the Original Language means balsam. That it was an ointment, or thickly oily, is evident. Hence it is that resin = the truth of good which is in the Natural; in the present case, in the exterior Natural, because it is set in the first place...
All the houses (of those from the Copper Age) were of the wood of trees of resin.
